fichas.title: Hydraulic Lifts
fichas.summary: Hydraulic lifts are suited to heavy loads and shorter lift heights, with the machine room able to be located remotely from the shaft. Direct-acting piston lifts can carry payloads up to 20 t to a maximum height of 17 m; indirect-acting lifts can carry up to 7 t to a maximum height of 34 m. The page illustrates shaft plans, a vertical shaft section, technical data, and rucksack and tandem arrangements. A centrally mounted ram requires a bored hole, and retraction control must be maintained within ±3 mm regardless of load.
uses: Lifting goods or passengers over shorter lift heights

dimensions.context: Hydraulic lifts are described as best used for lift heights up to this height.
